The '''Esaga sector''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]], dominated&mdash;at various times before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]&mdash;by either the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] or the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], with a period of [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith]] rule. By [[137 ABY]], the sector had come into the possession of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the sector was ruled by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Haveland/Legends|Haveland]].<ref name="GNN9" />
